sections.heading: Examples
sections.text: An Schultagen ist hier von 7 bis 9 Uhr Halteverbot. :: On school days there is no stopping here from 7 to 9. Das Halteverbot gilt nicht für Linienbusse. :: The no-stopping rule does not apply to scheduled buses.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: Halten is stopping for up to three minutes, Parken is longer or leaving the car. A red cross on blue is the absolute ban ( absolutes Halteverbot ); a single red stripe is the limited one ( eingeschränktes Halteverbot ), where you may stop for three minutes but not park.
